Emergency electrician Perth: service scope

  • Accept urgent private electrical repair requests 24 hours a day, including nights and weekends.
  • Investigate affected circuits, safety switches, outlets and lighting within the agreed repair scope.
  • Confirm the initial assessment and any subsequent repair or replacement separately in the plan and quote.
  • No guaranteed arrival time, free emergency attendance or public network repair is implied. Solar, batteries, gas and appliance internal repairs remain separate specialist scopes.

We confirm the property, installation and requested outcome before selecting the work. Fixed plumbing and electrical tasks are handled by the appropriate qualified trade; a coordinated visit does not make every task interchangeable. Current documentation relevant to the proposed work can be requested privately.

24-Hour Emergency Electrician Perth FAQs

Prepare the request and approval

Give the property location, observable symptoms or intended installation, access contact and the person who can approve the work. The agreed quote sets out the assessment and work; submitting a form does not reserve an appointment.

  • Perth electrical services
  • Partial power loss and fault finding
  • A safety switch that will not reset
  • Damaged or failed power points
  • Routine electrical enquiries
Is an emergency electrician available after hours?

Yes. We provide 24-hour emergency electrical repairs. Call 0413 477 667 with the address and condition to confirm arrangements and charges. For immediate danger, use the appropriate emergency or utility contact first.

When should I call Western Power instead of a private electrician?

Shock or tingling, fallen or damaged network equipment and network emergencies need Western Power on 13 13 51. Call 000 for life-threatening danger or fire. Report supply interruptions through Western Power before assuming a private installation fault.

What information helps an electrician prepare for a power fault?

State the address, affected lights or outlets, when it began, any visible warning signs and whether a supply interruption is reported. Do not remove covers or approach damaged equipment to gather details.

How are emergency electrical repairs charged?

Charges follow the quoted work plan, including agreed attendance, investigation and repair inclusions. An unresolved or intermittent fault may need further investigation, which must be discussed rather than assumed to be included without limit.
